mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_operate_time (store_id, opened_at, date) SELECT #{storeId}, NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM store_operate_time WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND DATE(date) = CURRENT_DATE() )
mapper.update: UPDATE store_operate_time SET closed_at = NOW() WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND DATE(date) = CURRENT_DATE()
mapper.select: SELECT T.store_op_time_id AS storeOpTimeId, T.store_id, T.opened_at, T.closed_at FROM store_operate_time T INNER JOIN ( SELECT store_id, MAX(opened_at) AS max_opened_at FROM store_operate_time GROUP BY store_id ) latest ON T.store_id = latest.store_id AND T.opened_at = latest.max_opened_at INNER JOIN stores S ON S.store_id = T.store_id INNER JOIN users U ON S.user_id = U.user_id WHERE U.user_id = #{userId};
